scripts.watch: concurrently --prefix "[{time}]" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow" "cd extension && npm run watch:content" "cd extension && npm run watch:background" "cd popup && npm run watch"
scripts.build: concurrently --prefix "[{time}]" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "cd extension && npm run build" "cd popup && npm run build"
scripts.build:dev: concurrently --prefix "[{time}]" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "cd extension && npm run build:dev" "cd popup && npm run build"
scripts.release: npm run check:listing && npm run build && node scripts/archive.js && npm run source-archive
scripts.release:chrome: npm run check:listing && npm run build && node scripts/archive.js chrome
scripts.release:edge: npm run check:listing && npm run build && node scripts/archive.js edge
scripts.release:firefox: npm run check:listing && npm run build && node scripts/archive.js firefox
scripts.release:dev: npm run build:dev && node scripts/archive.js dev
scripts.release:chrome:dev: npm run build:dev && node scripts/archive.js chrome dev
scripts.release:edge:dev: npm run build:dev && node scripts/archive.js edge dev
scripts.release:firefox:dev: npm run build:dev && node scripts/archive.js firefox dev
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix extension && npm run lint --prefix popup
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix extension && npm run typecheck --prefix popup
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm test --prefix extension && npm test --prefix popup
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage --prefix extension && npm run coverage --prefix popup
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-deps.js && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:scripts && npm run coverage && npm run check:listing && npm run check:version
